messages:
irene: Heads up — eu2 rack-09 started failing provisioning around 06:05 UTC after yesterday's out-of-band BMC image deploy. Nodes enter PXE, then drop to BIOS with boot-order swapped. NVMe-backed GPU nodes stuck in 'awaiting image' for 6+ minutes :warning:
sam: Can you paste the last logs from the provisioner? Is this only rack-09 or broader?
irene: only rack-09 so far. I grabbed serial logs from one node.
alex: ```
[06:04:58] oob-bmc: POST /images/apply -> 200
[06:05:03] bmc: nvram write ok
[06:05:09] bios: bootorder=network->disk (expected disk->network)
[06:05:09] kernel: no root found
[06:05:09] systemd: provisioning-timeout
``` 
eng-bot: deploy-bot: completed job 4591 on eu2 with image bmc-v2.3.8 at 2026-03-19T05:58:00Z
kevin: Looks like the new image flips UEFI BootOrder when NVRAM checksum absent. We've seen similar on older boards. Workaround: set force-boot-order flag in the provisioner to re-write after BMC apply.
sam: Can we patch provisioner and roll restart just for rack-09? Want to avoid global churn.
irene: I'll pin rack-09 to bmc-v2.3.7 via the management plane and trigger a reprovision of the 8 affected nodes.
maria: Heads up — this is blocking ~120 GPU-hours; projected cost if prolonged ~ $1.8k/day. Need ETA.
kevin: If pin + reprovision works, we should coordinate a targeted rollback and postmortem. I'll open an alert runbook.
alex: quick script I'm running now to normalize bootorder after apply:
```bash
for host in $(cat /tmp/affected); do
  oobctl --host $host set-nvram BootOrder disk,network
  oobctl --host $host reboot
done
```
irene: ran on 4/8 nodes so far — 3 back to provisioning, 1 still cycling NVRAM write errors.
sam: assign oncall to stay on the thread for the next hour, please. @kevin @alex
kevin: oncall me, I'll follow. If we fail to stabilize in 30m we move to full rack rollback to v2.3.7.
maria: adding leadership FYI: cc @ops-leads — cost/impact note logged.
irene: update 06:15 UTC — 6/8 nodes reprovisioned successfully. Two nodes show persistent nvram write failures, opening hardware ticket with vendor.
kevin: noted. we'll treat those as potential flaky NVRAM chips and schedule RMA if vendor confirms.
eng-bot: incident: create IN-2026-0319-08 for eu2-rack-09 nvram-provision-churn
irene: thanks team, will follow up with root cause once vendor confirms whether image changed nvram layout.
maria: please include the cost delta in the incident notes and tag finance.
sam: thx — closing loop for now, keeping thread open for vendor response.
